ObjectStates.LuaScript:
-- ===== Hourglass — a tiered vessel of elemental grains =====
-- Top = grains in time; bottom = grains fallen into timelessness.
-- Timeless when more grains sit on the bottom than the top (bdo's rule).
-- The hourglass itself is a resource: its tier bounds total grains.
-- GM Notes JSON: {"tier":3, "top":{"Fire":5}, "bottom":{}}

-- ===== Catalyst Core: The 13th Hour — shared block =====
-- Generated by tabletop/forge.py from game.spec.json.
-- Edit tabletop/lua/ + the spec, never build/ output.

CC = {
  game = "Catalyst Core: The 13th Hour",
  elements = {
    { addr = 0, name = "Void", opposite = "Aether", role = "Absence, nothingness", color = { r = 0.1, g = 0.06, b = 0.16 } },
    { addr = 1, name = "Fire", opposite = "Water", role = "Destruction, energy", color = { r = 0.89, g = 0.35, b = 0.12 } },
    { addr = 2, name = "Earth", opposite = "Air", role = "Stability, substance", color = { r = 0.48, g = 0.31, b = 0.13 } },
    { addr = 3, name = "Order", opposite = "Chaos", role = "Structure, pattern", color = { r = 0.91, g = 0.77, b = 0.25 } },
    { addr = 4, name = "Chaos", opposite = "Order", role = "Entropy, disruption", color = { r = 0.7, g = 0.09, b = 0.43 } },
    { addr = 5, name = "Air", opposite = "Earth", role = "Freedom, mobility", color = { r = 0.75, g = 0.85, b = 0.91 } },
    { addr = 6, name = "Water", opposite = "Fire", role = "Adaptation, flow", color = { r = 0.18, g = 0.53, b = 0.87 } },
    { addr = 7, name = "Aether", opposite = "Void", role = "Transcendence, resonance", color = { r = 0.56, g = 0.37, b = 0.85 } },
  },
  tiers = {
    { tier = 1, capacity = 10, timecoin = 100 },
    { tier = 2, capacity = 25, timecoin = 500 },
    { tier = 3, capacity = 50, timecoin = 1500 },
    { tier = 4, capacity = 75, timecoin = 4000 },
    { tier = 5, capacity = 100, timecoin = 10000 },
  },
  races = {
    { name = "Mortal", is = "Void", wants = "(contextual)", weak = "Aether" },
    { name = "Primal", is = "Fire", wants = "Aether", weak = "Water" },
    { name = "Golem", is = "Earth", wants = "Water", weak = "Air" },
    { name = "Chimeral", is = "Order", wants = "Fire", weak = "Chaos" },
    { name = "Revenant", is = "Chaos", wants = "Air", weak = "Order" },
    { name = "Outsider", is = "Air", wants = "Aether", weak = "Earth" },
  },
  classes = {
    { name = "Lord", is = "Aether", wants = "Chaos", weak = "Void", ability = "Command: forcefully move a persona to a location or order it to interact with an event." },
    { name = "Keeper", is = "Chaos", wants = "Earth", weak = "Order", ability = "(open — holds the line between what is and what was)" },
    { name = "Magus", is = "Water", wants = "Air", weak = "Fire", ability = "Transmute Void/Aether: transmute an element into Void or Aether, whichever it is most similar to." },
    { name = "Weaver", is = "Order", wants = "Fire", weak = "Chaos", ability = "(open — imposes pattern on noise)" },
    { name = "Mercer", is = "Earth", wants = "Water", weak = "Air", ability = "(open — moves value across the Rift)" },
  },
  clock = { hours = 12, max_turns = 12, eon_message = "Eon, you have awakened. The end time has come — he arrives in {turns} turns." },
  currency = { name = "Timecoin", start = 100, denominations = { 10, 100, 1000 } },
  attention = { name = "AP", per_turn = 3 },
  shapes = {
    { label = "Block", tts = "BlockSquare" },
    { label = "Slab", tts = "BlockRectangle" },
    { label = "Wedge", tts = "BlockTriangle" },
    { label = "Pawn", tts = "PlayerPawn" },
    { label = "Die", tts = "Die_6" },
    { label = "Chip", tts = "Chip_100" },
    { label = "Checker", tts = "Checker_white" },
  },
}

function ccElem(name)
  if name == nil then return nil end
  local n = string.lower(tostring(name))
  for _, e in ipairs(CC.elements) do
    if string.lower(e.name) == n then return e end
  end
  return nil
end

function ccTier(t)
  for _, row in ipairs(CC.tiers) do
    if row.tier == t then return row end
  end
  return CC.tiers[1]
end

function ccTotal(pool)
  local n = 0
  for _, v in pairs(pool or {}) do n = n + (tonumber(v) or 0) end
  return n
end

function ccFmtPool(pool)
  local parts = {}
  for _, e in ipairs(CC.elements) do
    local v = (pool or {})[e.name]
    if v ~= nil and v ~= 0 then table.insert(parts, e.name .. " " .. v) end
  end
  if #parts == 0 then return "empty" end
  return table.concat(parts, " | ")
end

-- Every scripted object is generic + flexible: its config comes from its
-- GM Notes as JSON, merged over the given defaults. Repurpose any object
-- in-game by editing GM Notes, no Lua required.
function ccNotesConfig(defaults)
  local cfg = {}
  for k, v in pairs(defaults or {}) do cfg[k] = v end
  local notes = self.getGMNotes()
  if notes ~= nil and notes ~= "" then
    local ok, parsed = pcall(function() return JSON.decode(notes) end)
    if ok and type(parsed) == "table" then
      for k, v in pairs(parsed) do cfg[k] = v end
    end
  end
  return cfg
end

-- Buttons in scale-compensated local space: the same template works on an
-- object of any scale (the "generic shapes" promise).
function ccBtn(p)
  local s = self.getScale()
  p.function_owner = self
  p.position = { p.position[1] / s.x, p.position[2] / s.y, p.position[3] / s.z }
  p.rotation = p.rotation or { 0, 180, 0 }
  local fw = (p.width == 0 and p.height == 0)  -- width 0 + height 0 = pure label
  p.width = fw and 0 or math.max(1, math.floor((p.width or 320) / s.x))
  p.height = fw and 0 or math.max(1, math.floor((p.height or 320) / s.z))
  p.font_size = math.max(1, math.floor((p.font_size or 120) / s.x))
  self.createButton(p)
end

function ccEnsureTag(tag)
  if not self.hasTag(tag) then self.addTag(tag) end
end


local state = { tier = 1, sel = 2, top = {}, bottom = {} }

function onSave() return JSON.encode(state) end

function onLoad(saved)
  local restored = false
  if saved ~= nil and saved ~= "" then
    local ok, s = pcall(function() return JSON.decode(saved) end)
    if ok and type(s) == "table" and s.top ~= nil then
      state = s
      restored = true
    end
  end
  if not restored then
    local cfg = ccNotesConfig({ tier = 1, top = {}, bottom = {} })
    state.tier = tonumber(cfg.tier) or 1
    state.top = cfg.top or {}
    state.bottom = cfg.bottom or {}
    state.sel = state.sel or 2
  end
  ccEnsureTag("cc-holder")
  ccEnsureTag("cc-hourglass")
  buildUI()
  refresh()
end

local function selName() return CC.elements[state.sel].name end
local function used() return ccTotal(state.top) + ccTotal(state.bottom) end
local function isTimeless() return ccTotal(state.bottom) > ccTotal(state.top) end

function buildUI()
  self.clearButtons()
  ccBtn({ click_function = "ccNoop", label = "", position = { 0, 0.58, -0.30 },
          width = 0, height = 0, font_size = 130 })                       -- 0 headline
  ccBtn({ click_function = "hgPrev", label = "<", position = { -0.34, 0.58, 0 },
          width = 220, height = 220, font_size = 130 })                   -- 1
  ccBtn({ click_function = "ccNoop", label = "", position = { 0, 0.58, 0 },
          width = 0, height = 0, font_size = 130 })                       -- 2 element label
  ccBtn({ click_function = "hgNext", label = ">", position = { 0.34, 0.58, 0 },
          width = 220, height = 220, font_size = 130 })                   -- 3
  ccBtn({ click_function = "hgMinus", label = "-", position = { -0.34, 0.58, 0.30 },
          width = 220, height = 220, font_size = 140 })                   -- 4
  ccBtn({ click_function = "hgPlus", label = "+", position = { -0.12, 0.58, 0.30 },
          width = 220, height = 220, font_size = 140 })                   -- 5
  ccBtn({ click_function = "hgDrop", label = "v", position = { 0.12, 0.58, 0.30 },
          width = 220, height = 220, font_size = 130,
          tooltip = "Spend: one grain falls into timelessness" })         -- 6
  ccBtn({ click_function = "hgRaise", label = "^", position = { 0.34, 0.58, 0.30 },
          width = 220, height = 220, font_size = 130,
          tooltip = "Reclaim: one grain rises back into time" })          -- 7
end

function refresh()
  local cap = ccTier(state.tier).capacity
  local head = "T" .. state.tier .. "  " .. ccTotal(state.top) .. "^ "
      .. ccTotal(state.bottom) .. "v / " .. cap
  if isTimeless() then head = head .. "  TIMELESS" end
  local e = CC.elements[state.sel]
  self.editButton({ index = 0, label = head })
  self.editButton({ index = 2,
    label = e.name .. " " .. (state.top[e.name] or 0) .. "^" .. (state.bottom[e.name] or 0) .. "v",
    font_color = { e.color.r, e.color.g, e.color.b } })
  self.setName("Hourglass T" .. state.tier .. (isTimeless() and " (TIMELESS)" or ""))
  self.setDescription("Capacity " .. cap .. " grains | worth "
      .. ccTier(state.tier).timecoin .. " " .. CC.currency.name
      .. "\nTop (in time): " .. ccFmtPool(state.top)
      .. "\nBottom (timeless): " .. ccFmtPool(state.bottom))
  if isTimeless() then
    self.setColorTint({ 0.25, 0.20, 0.35 })
  else
    local t = state.tier
    self.setColorTint({ 0.55 + 0.08 * t, 0.50 + 0.06 * t, 0.35 })
  end
end

function ccNoop() end
function hgPrev() state.sel = (state.sel - 2) % #CC.elements + 1; refresh() end
function hgNext() state.sel = state.sel % #CC.elements + 1; refresh() end

function hgPlus()
  if used() >= ccTier(state.tier).capacity then
    broadcastToAll("Hourglass T" .. state.tier .. " is full ("
        .. ccTier(state.tier).capacity .. " grains) — a higher tier holds more.",
        { 0.9, 0.6, 0.2 })
    return
  end
  state.top[selName()] = (state.top[selName()] or 0) + 1
  refresh()
end

function hgMinus()
  local n = state.top[selName()] or 0
  if n > 0 then state.top[selName()] = n - 1 end
  refresh()
end

function hgDrop()
  local n = state.top[selName()] or 0
  if n > 0 then
    state.top[selName()] = n - 1
    state.bottom[selName()] = (state.bottom[selName()] or 0) + 1
    if isTimeless() then
      broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " has slipped into TIMELESSNESS.", { 0.6, 0.4, 0.9 })
    end
  end
  refresh()
end

function hgRaise()
  local n = state.bottom[selName()] or 0
  if n > 0 then
    state.bottom[selName()] = n - 1
    state.top[selName()] = (state.top[selName()] or 0) + 1
  end
  refresh()
end

-- Census / automation seam: other objects read and feed this vessel.
function ccGetPool()
  return { kind = "hourglass", tier = state.tier, top = state.top,
           bottom = state.bottom, timeless = isTimeless() }
end

-- params: {element="Fire", n=1, side="top"|"bottom"}; refuses past capacity.
function ccAddGrain(params)
  local e = ccElem(params.element)
  if e == nil then return false end
  local n = tonumber(params.n) or 1
  local side = (params.side == "bottom") and "bottom" or "top"
  if used() + n > ccTier(state.tier).capacity then return false end
  state[side][e.name] = (state[side][e.name] or 0) + n
  refresh()
  return true
end

    { name = "Outsider", is = "Air", wants = "Aether", weak = "Earth" },

    { name = "Lord", is = "Aether", wants = "Chaos", weak = "Void", ability = "Command: forcefully move a persona to a location or order it to interact with an event." },

  if name == nil then return nil end
  local n = string.lower(tostring(name))
  for _, e in ipairs(CC.elements) do
    if string.lower(e.name) == n then return e end
  end
  return nil
end

function ccTier(t)
  for _, row in ipairs(CC.tiers) do
    if row.tier == t then return row end
  end
  return CC.tiers[1]
end

function ccTotal(pool)
  local n = 0
  for _, v in pairs(pool or {}) do n = n + (tonumber(v) or 0) end
  return n
end

  local parts = {}
  for _, e in ipairs(CC.elements) do
    local v = (pool or {})[e.name]

  return table.concat(parts, " | ")

  for k, v in pairs(defaults or {}) do cfg[k] = v end

  if notes ~= nil and notes ~= "" then
    local ok, parsed = pcall(function() return JSON.decode(notes) end)
    if ok and type(parsed) == "table" then
      for k, v in pairs(parsed) do cfg[k] = v end

  end

end

  p.height = fw and 0 or math.max(1, math.floor((p.height or 320) / s.z))

  buildUI()
  refresh()
end

  ccBtn({ click_function = "hgMinus", label = "-", position = { -0.34, 0.58, 0.30 },

  ccBtn({ click_function = "hgPlus", label = "+", position = { -0.12, 0.58, 0.30 },
          width = 220, height = 220, font_size = 140 })                   -- 5
  ccBtn({ click_function = "hgDrop", label = "v", position = { 0.12, 0.58, 0.30 },
          width = 220, height = 220, font_size = 130,
          tooltip = "Spend: one grain falls into timelessness" })         -- 6
  ccBtn({ click_function = "hgRaise", label = "^", position = { 0.34, 0.58, 0.30 },
          width = 220, height = 220, font_size = 130,
          tooltip = "Reclaim: one grain rises back into time" })          -- 7
end

function refresh()
  local cap = ccTier(state.tier).capacity
  local head = "T" .. state.tier .. "  " .. ccTotal(state.top) .. "^ "
      .. ccTotal(state.bottom) .. "v / " .. cap
  if isTimeless() then head = head .. "  TIMELESS" end

  self.editButton({ index = 0, label = head })

    label = e.name .. " " .. (state.top[e.name] or 0) .. "^" .. (state.bottom[e.name] or 0) .. "v",

  self.setDescription("Capacity " .. cap .. " grains | worth "
      .. ccTier(state.tier).timecoin .. " " .. CC.currency.name
      .. "\nTop (in time): " .. ccFmtPool(state.top)
      .. "\nBottom (timeless): " .. ccFmtPool(state.bottom))

    self.setColorTint({ 0.25, 0.20, 0.35 })
  else
    local t = state.tier
    self.setColorTint({ 0.55 + 0.08 * t, 0.50 + 0.06 * t, 0.35 })
  end
end

function ccNoop() end
function hgPrev() state.sel = (state.sel - 2) % #CC.elements + 1; refresh() end
function hgNext() state.sel = state.sel % #CC.elements + 1; refresh() end

function hgPlus()
  if used() >= ccTier(state.tier).capacity then

  end
  state.top[selName()] = (state.top[selName()] or 0) + 1
  refresh()
end

function hgMinus()
  local n = state.top[selName()] or 0
  if n > 0 then state.top[selName()] = n - 1 end
  refresh()
end

function hgDrop()
  local n = state.top[selName()] or 0
  if n > 0 then
    state.top[selName()] = n - 1
    state.bottom[selName()] = (state.bottom[selName()] or 0) + 1

  end
  refresh()
end

  local n = state.bottom[selName()] or 0

    state.bottom[selName()] = n - 1

  end
  refresh()
end

end

function ccAddGrain(params)
  local e = ccElem(params.element)
  if e == nil then return false end
  local n = tonumber(params.n) or 1
  local side = (params.side == "bottom") and "bottom" or "top"
  if used() + n > ccTier(state.tier).capacity then return false end
  state[side][e.name] = (state[side][e.name] or 0) + n
  refresh()
  return true
end

function ccElem(name)
  if name == nil then return nil end
  local n = string.lower(tostring(name))
  for _, e in ipairs(CC.elements) do
    if string.lower(e.name) == n then return e end
  end
  return nil
end

function ccTier(t)
  for _, row in ipairs(CC.tiers) do
    if row.tier == t then return row end
  end
  return CC.tiers[1]
end

function ccTotal(pool)
  local n = 0
  for _, v in pairs(pool or {}) do n = n + (tonumber(v) or 0) end
  return n
end

function ccFmtPool(pool)
  local parts = {}
  for _, e in ipairs(CC.elements) do
    local v = (pool or {})[e.name]
    if v ~= nil and v ~= 0 then table.insert(parts, e.name .. " " .. v) end
  end
  if #parts == 0 then return "empty" end
  return table.concat(parts, " | ")
end

-- Every scripted object is generic + flexible: its config comes from its
-- GM Notes as JSON, merged over the given defaults. Repurpose any object
-- in-game by editing GM Notes, no Lua required.
function ccNotesConfig(defaults)
  local cfg = {}
  for k, v in pairs(defaults or {}) do cfg[k] = v end
  local notes = self.getGMNotes()
  if notes ~= nil and notes ~= "" then
    local ok, parsed = pcall(function() return JSON.decode(notes) end)
    if ok and type(parsed) == "table" then
      for k, v in pairs(parsed) do cfg[k] = v end
    end
  end
  return cfg
end

-- Buttons in scale-compensated local space: the same template works on an
-- object of any scale (the "generic shapes" promise).
function ccBtn(p)
  local s = self.getScale()
  p.function_owner = self
  p.position = { p.position[1] / s.x, p.position[2] / s.y, p.position[3] / s.z }
  p.rotation = p.rotation or { 0, 180, 0 }
  local fw = (p.width == 0 and p.height == 0)  -- width 0 + height 0 = pure label
  p.width = fw and 0 or math.max(1, math.floor((p.width or 320) / s.x))
  p.height = fw and 0 or math.max(1, math.floor((p.height or 320) / s.z))
  p.font_size = math.max(1, math.floor((p.font_size or 120) / s.x))
  self.createButton(p)
end

function ccEnsureTag(tag)
  if not self.hasTag(tag) then self.addTag(tag) end
end


local state = { tier = 1, sel = 2, top = {}, bottom = {} }

function onSave() return JSON.encode(state) end

function onLoad(saved)
  local restored = false
  if saved ~= nil and saved ~= "" then
    local ok, s = pcall(function() return JSON.decode(saved) end)
    if ok and type(s) == "table" and s.top ~= nil then
      state = s
      restored = true
    end
  end
  if not restored then
    local cfg = ccNotesConfig({ tier = 1, top = {}, bottom = {} })
    state.tier = tonumber(cfg.tier) or 1
    state.top = cfg.top or {}
    state.bottom = cfg.bottom or {}
    state.sel = state.sel or 2
  end
  ccEnsureTag("cc-holder")
  ccEnsureTag("cc-hourglass")
  buildUI()
  refresh()
end

local function selName() return CC.elements[state.sel].name end
local function used() return ccTotal(state.top) + ccTotal(state.bottom) end
local function isTimeless() return ccTotal(state.bottom) > ccTotal(state.top) end

function buildUI()
  self.clearButtons()
  ccBtn({ click_function = "ccNoop", label = "", position = { 0, 0.58, -0.30 },
          width = 0, height = 0, font_size = 130 })                       -- 0 headline
  ccBtn({ click_function = "hgPrev", label = "<", position = { -0.34, 0.58, 0 },
          width = 220, height = 220, font_size = 130 })                   -- 1
  ccBtn({ click_function = "ccNoop", label = "", position = { 0, 0.58, 0 },
          width = 0, height = 0, font_size = 130 })                       -- 2 element label
  ccBtn({ click_function = "hgNext", label = ">", position = { 0.34, 0.58, 0 },
          width = 220, height = 220, font_size = 130 })                   -- 3
  ccBtn({ click_function = "hgMinus", label = "-", position = { -0.34, 0.58, 0.30 },
          width = 220, height = 220, font_size = 140 })                   -- 4
  ccBtn({ click_function = "hgPlus", label = "+", position = { -0.12, 0.58, 0.30 },
          width = 220, height = 220, font_size = 140 })                   -- 5
  ccBtn({ click_function = "hgDrop", label = "v", position = { 0.12, 0.58, 0.30 },
          width = 220, height = 220, font_size = 130,
          tooltip = "Spend: one grain falls into timelessness" })         -- 6
  ccBtn({ click_function = "hgRaise", label = "^", position = { 0.34, 0.58, 0.30 },
          width = 220, height = 220, font_size = 130,
          tooltip = "Reclaim: one grain rises back into time" })          -- 7
end

function refresh()
  local cap = ccTier(state.tier).capacity
  local head = "T" .. state.tier .. "  " .. ccTotal(state.top) .. "^ "
      .. ccTotal(state.bottom) .. "v / " .. cap
  if isTimeless() then head = head .. "  TIMELESS" end
  local e = CC.elements[state.sel]
  self.editButton({ index = 0, label = head })
  self.editButton({ index = 2,
    label = e.name .. " " .. (state.top[e.name] or 0) .. "^" .. (state.bottom[e.name] or 0) .. "v",
    font_color = { e.color.r, e.color.g, e.color.b } })
  self.setName("Hourglass T" .. state.tier .. (isTimeless() and " (TIMELESS)" or ""))
  self.setDescription("Capacity " .. cap .. " grains | worth "
      .. ccTier(state.tier).timecoin .. " " .. CC.currency.name
      .. "\nTop (in time): " .. ccFmtPool(state.top)
      .. "\nBottom (timeless): " .. ccFmtPool(state.bottom))
  if isTimeless() then
    self.setColorTint({ 0.25, 0.20, 0.35 })
  else
    local t = state.tier
    self.setColorTint({ 0.55 + 0.08 * t, 0.50 + 0.06 * t, 0.35 })
  end
end

function ccNoop() end
function hgPrev() state.sel = (state.sel - 2) % #CC.elements + 1; refresh() end
function hgNext() state.sel = state.sel % #CC.elements + 1; refresh() end

function hgPlus()
  if used() >= ccTier(state.tier).capacity then
    broadcastToAll("Hourglass T" .. state.tier .. " is full ("
        .. ccTier(state.tier).capacity .. " grains) — a higher tier holds more.",
        { 0.9, 0.6, 0.2 })
    return
  end
  state.top[selName()] = (state.top[selName()] or 0) + 1
  refresh()
end

function hgMinus()
  local n = state.top[selName()] or 0
  if n > 0 then state.top[selName()] = n - 1 end
  refresh()
end

function hgDrop()
  local n = state.top[selName()] or 0
  if n > 0 then
    state.top[selName()] = n - 1
    state.bottom[selName()] = (state.bottom[selName()] or 0) + 1
    if isTimeless() then
      broadcastToAll(self.getName() .. " has slipped into TIMELESSNESS.", { 0.6, 0.4, 0.9 })
    end
  end
  refresh()
end

function hgRaise()
  local n = state.bottom[selName()] or 0
  if n > 0 then
    state.bottom[selName()] = n - 1
    state.top[selName()] = (state.top[selName()] or 0) + 1
  end
  refresh()
end

-- Census / automation seam: other objects read and feed this vessel.
function ccGetPool()
  return { kind = "hourglass", tier = state.tier, top = state.top,
           bottom = state.bottom, timeless = isTimeless() }
end

-- params: {element="Fire", n=1, side="top"|"bottom"}; refuses past capacity.
function ccAddGrain(params)
  local e = ccElem(params.element)
  if e == nil then return false end
  local n = tonumber(params.n) or 1
  local side = (params.side == "bottom") and "bottom" or "top"
  if used() + n > ccTier(state.tier).capacity then return false end
  state[side][e.name] = (state[side][e.name] or 0) + n
  refresh()
  return true
end
